dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、さて帰るか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, well. Let's go home."
dialogues.text: "Oh, well. Let's go home."

dialogues.jp:
鞄と一緒に手を上げて背伸びをして、だらだら
と桜並木を進む。
dialogues.en:
I stretch as I walk along the row of cherry blossomtrees
with a bag in my hand.
dialogues.text:
I stretch as I walk along the row of cherry blossomtrees
with a bag in my hand.

dialogues.jp:
肺にいっぱいに桜の匂いが流れ込み、思わず笑
みがこぼれる。
dialogues.en: The aroma of cherry blossoms makes me smile.
dialogues.text: The aroma of cherry blossoms makes me smile.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
とっとこ、と前触れなくさくらが目の前を通り
ぬけていった。
dialogues.en: Out of the blue, Sakura passes by in front of me.
dialogues.text: Out of the blue, Sakura passes by in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
目で追っていると、ある程度のところで引き返
してきて、また目の前を通り過ぎていく。
dialogues.en:
As I watch the direction she goes, she turns around, walks
back toward me and walks by once again.
dialogues.text:
As I watch the direction she goes, she turns around, walks
back toward me and walks by once again.

dialogues.jp: 「……５円玉を使わない新手の催眠術か？」
dialogues.en: "Is it a new magic without using a dime?"
dialogues.text: "Is it a new magic without using a dime?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お兄ちゃんだ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
独り言を聞きつけて、また小走りに引き返して
くる。
dialogues.en: She hears my mumbling and runs back to me.
dialogues.text: She hears my mumbling and runs back to me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「帰るの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going home now?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going home now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「かったるいけど、家に帰らないともっとだる
　いからな……」
dialogues.en:
"It's tiring, but if I don't go home now, I'll be exhausted
later."
dialogues.text:
"It's tiring, but if I don't go home now, I'll be exhausted
later."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あにゃ……そのうち、面倒だからって家に引
　きこもりそうだね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, he may not leave the house any time soon, because
everything seems too much of a bother for him."
dialogues.text:
"Well, he may not leave the house any time soon, because
everything seems too much of a bother for him."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その言葉は耳にタコだ」
dialogues.en: "Are you talking about me?"
dialogues.text: "Are you talking about me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「のれんに腕押し。｛ばじとうふう／馬耳東風｝。馬の耳に念仏だ
　ね♪」
dialogues.en:
"It's like beating the air, or in one ear and out the other,
or water off a duck's back."
dialogues.text:
"It's like beating the air, or in one ear and out the other,
or water off a duck's back."

dialogues.jp:
授業でならったことを親に自慢するように、さ
くらが指折り俺をけなしてくれる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura teases me with what she learned in class, like a
child showing off to her parents.
dialogues.text:
Sakura teases me with what she learned in class, like a
child showing off to her parents.

dialogues.jp: 「……実は喧嘩売ってるのかお前？」
dialogues.en: "Are you picking a fight with me?"
dialogues.text: "Are you picking a fight with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「？　なにが？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、いい。すでにお前に言い返せる｛ことわざ／諺｝が見
　つからない」
dialogues.en: "Never mind. I can't think of any proverb that fits you."
dialogues.text: "Never mind. I can't think of any proverb that fits you."

dialogues.jp:
この程度で聞くような玉なら、俺も苦労を積み
重ねてはこなかったのだろう。
dialogues.en:
If she were this easy, I wouldn't have had any tough times
with her before.
dialogues.text:
If she were this easy, I wouldn't have had any tough times
with her before.

dialogues.jp: 「で、お前はなにをやってたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So, what were you doing before?"
dialogues.text: "So, what were you doing before?"

dialogues.jp:
あっち〜こっち、とさくらが移動していた道を
指でたどって首をかしげる。
dialogues.en:
I point at all the directions she walked and cock my head
enquiringly.
dialogues.text:
I point at all the directions she walked and cock my head
enquiringly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「探検だよ！」
dialogues.en: "I just went exploring!"
dialogues.text: "I just went exploring!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……どこかに、この島に隠された財宝の地図
　でも落ちてたか？」
dialogues.en: "Did you find a map of a treasure hidden on this island?"
dialogues.text: "Did you find a map of a treasure hidden on this island?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うんん。どこになにがあるのか調べて地図を
　作っているんだよ。小さい頃社会科での授業
　でやったでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Nope. It's just a regular map. Because I want to get to
know the area."
dialogues.text:
"Nope. It's just a regular map. Because I want to get to
know the area."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、そっちね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, exploring with a map."
dialogues.text: "Oh, exploring with a map."

dialogues.jp: 恐ろしく懐かしいな。
dialogues.en: It sounds so nostalgic to me.
dialogues.text: It sounds so nostalgic to me.

dialogues.jp: 「学園の周りをまず調べてるのか」
dialogues.en: "Are you checking the surroundings of the school first?"
dialogues.text: "Are you checking the surroundings of the school first?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん……あ〜、自分で見て回りたいから、残
　念だけど付いてこなくていいからね」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, um... I want to look around by myself, so you can go
home now."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, um... I want to look around by myself, so you can go
home now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でもでも、嫌いになったわけじゃないよ！」
dialogues.en: "But it doesn't mean I don't need you any more!"
dialogues.text: "But it doesn't mean I don't need you any more!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「分かってるって」
dialogues.en: "I know."
dialogues.text: "I know."

dialogues.jp:
すがってくるさくらの頭をなで、苦笑いを隠す
ように小さく｛あくび／欠伸｝をする。
dialogues.en:
I stroke her head as she clings on my arm, then I give a
little yawn to cover up a wry grin.
dialogues.text:
I stroke her head as she clings on my arm, then I give a
little yawn to cover up a wry grin.

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、がんばれや」
dialogues.en: "Well, good luck."
dialogues.text: "Well, good luck."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ばいば〜いび〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Bye-bye~"
dialogues.text: "Bye-bye~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
背中越しに手を上げて答えながら、少しだけ軽
くなった足取りで俺は家路についた。
dialogues.en:
I reply with a wave of my hand. Then I walk home with steps
lighter than before.
dialogues.text:
I reply with a wave of my hand. Then I walk home with steps
lighter than before.

dialogues.jp: ◆探検発見ボクの島◆
dialogues.en: ◆My island that I found◆
dialogues.text: ◆My island that I found◆

dialogues.jp:
学園の前を行ったり来たりと走り回るさくら。
なんでも、周囲の地図を作成しているらしい。
dialogues.en:
Sakura runs up and down around the school to make her own
map.
dialogues.text:
Sakura runs up and down around the school to make her own
map.

dialogues.jp:
俺と一緒ではなく、こういうのはひとりでやり
たいと言うが、わざわざ俺が嫌いになったわけ
じゃないよと慌てるさくらが可愛かった。
dialogues.en:
She said she wanted to do it alone. After that she had to
make it clear to me that didn't mean she doesn't like me any
more. I thought how adorable she was.
dialogues.text:
She said she wanted to do it alone. After that she had to
make it clear to me that didn't mean she doesn't like me any
more. I thought how adorable she was.
